deploy-bot: Deploy started: prod release v1.4.2 tag=release/2026-03-20-1 commit=abc1234 initiator=@maya change_window=03:00-04:00UTC regions=[us, eu, apac] strategy=sequential canary=us

maya: Starting canary in us-east-1. Observability checks on (latency, errors, p50/p95).

liam: I'll watch tail of app logs and infra metrics. Alert thresholds set.

deploy-bot: us: canary finished ✅ instances healthy=12 errors=0. Proceeding to eu.

santiago: EU canary starting (eu-west-1). Rolling at 15% first.

deploy-bot: eu: rollout finished ✅ instances healthy=10, no regressions. Proceeding to apac.

deploy-bot: apac: rollout started (ap-southeast-1 -> ap-south-1) 10% -> 30%

jess: Observing increased 503s from apac gateways, sampling traces now. Seeing a few request timeouts to model cache.

oncall-bot: Alert: 502/503 spike in apac-lhr cluster (5m avg error rate 7%, threshold 3%).

maya: Hold the rollout, pausing APAC. @deploy-bot pause region=apac reason="error-spike"

deploy-bot: apac: rollout paused by maya. Current state=paused at 10%.

liam: I'm going to rollback APAC to the previous stable tag to restore traffic while we investigate. Rolling to release/2026-03-19-9 (commit=def9876).

deploy-bot: apac: rollback initiated -> target tag=release/2026-03-19-9 (initiated by liam)

deploy-bot: apac: rollback finished ✅ health checks passing, error rate back to baseline.

maya: Pinning APAC to previous release until root cause found. Command run: `redwoodctl pin-region --region apac --tag release/2026-03-19-9 --reason "503 spike"`

santiago: Collecting traces + core dumps from affected hosts. Edge config looks OK; suspect a bad kernel module or runtime upgrade on a subset of hosts.

jess: Adding brief release note: https://confluence.redwood/release/1.4.2 — APAC rollout paused & rolled back; US/EU are live. Investigation in progress.

maya: :thumbsup: Thanks all. If RCA takes >1h let's open a full incident. Keeping this thread for rollout notes and follow-ups.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: release v1.4.2 overall status=partial (us, eu success; apac reverted).
